## Checklist

- [ ] GitHub PR targets main and includes README, results JSON, and organization logo in `leaderboard/<policy_id>/`.
- [ ] Original Bench2Dex `per_episode.jsonl` and `summary.json` outputs are submitted separately to HF under `<policy_id>/`, targeting main; both PRs are cross-linked.
- [ ] At least Full results/logs are included; IDs, scores, coverage, and protocol agree between repositories.
- [ ] Submitted and linked content is sanitized and authorized for publication.
